描述_EN: this plate has been glazed in a modified version of the sancai colour scheme of the tang dynasty, known as song sancai. the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a stoneware body decorated with a bold design. the effect is a crisp and bold design in striking colours. the outlines of this lively design of ducks swimming in a lotus pond have been carved into the body to avoid the spread of the glazes during firing. this dish is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234).
描述_ZN: 此盘的釉面是唐代三彩的改进版，被称为宋三彩。 术语 "Cizhou "概括了中国北方几个地区制造的一系列器物，通常由一个石器主体装饰着大胆的设计。 效果是一个清晰而大胆的设计，颜色醒目。 这个活泼的鸭子在荷花池中游泳的图案的轮廓已经被刻在了盘身上，以避免烧制过程中釉料的扩散。 这个盘子是Cizhou ware的一个例子，Cizhou ware是中国北方地区在金朝（1115-1234）时期制造的一种陶瓷类型。
